description: Connect this server to a Snapchat ad account, from inside the chat. Step 1: call with no arguments; it returns a link for the person to open and approve. Step 2: the person pastes the address the browser landed on; call with redirected_url, and it saves access on this computer and lists the ad accounts. Step 3: call with ad_account_id to choose one, then the app must be restarted. Changes no ads.
name: snap_connect
